# Introduction

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Introduction

Lists help organize information in a sequential manner.

With CSS, you can style these lists to match the design of your webpage. In this lesson, you'll explore various list styles and customization options.

Let's look at an unstyled list:

```html
1<ul>
2    <li>Apple</li>
3    <li>Ball</li>
4    <li>Cat</li>
5</ul>
```

If you run this code, a plain list will appear on the page.

![HTML List](data:image/png;base64,)

You can customize how this list looks by altering its bullet points, margins, and padding.
